# Inventory – iOS Client & Backend

## Repositories & Major Surfaces
- `app/` — Expo Router React Native client (iOS primary) targeting bundle id `com.auro.app`. Handles auth, onboarding, reviews, payments, and push/MFA routes.
- `site/` — Next.js 13 app for marketing, reviewer console, and backend APIs (`site/app/api/**`). Hosts notification + payment distribution endpoints invoked from the mobile app.
- `supabase/` — Database schema migrations plus Edge Functions powering login/onboarding, payments, push, SMS, and Stripe webhooks.
- `scripts/` — Local node/PowerShell helpers to validate Stripe balances, Connect accounts, payouts, and API connectivity.
- `server/` — placeholder (empty) directory reserved for future dedicated backend.

## Mobile Config / Environment
- `app.json`
  - iOS bundle id `com.auro.app`, tablets supported, push notifications via `expo-notifications`.
  - Stripe React Native plugin configured with merchant id `merchant.com.auro`.
  - Associated domains include `applinks:app.appauro.com`.
  - `extra` block exposes:
    - `supabaseUrl` `https://zxazjbduiistnfstnwka.supabase.co`
    - `supabaseAnonKey` (anon JWT) – ensure rotated before production.
    - `stripePublishableKey` placeholder `pk_live_YOUR_LIVE_STRIPE_KEY_HERE` (must be replaced).
    - `apiUrl` pointing to Supabase Edge function `stripe_payment`.
    - `creatorWebBase` `https://www.appauro.com` (used for notifications + payment distribution).
    - `webCheckoutEnabled`, `universalLinkHost`, `deepLinkScheme`.
- `eas.json`
  - Defines dev/preview/prod profiles. Production submissions still contain placeholder Apple/Google credentials that must be filled before store release.
- Runtime env usage:
  - `lib/supabase.ts` requires `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`/`EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` at build time (falls back to Expo extras).
  - `lib/payments.ts` expects Stripe keys + backend URLs via `EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`, etc. Validate `.env` and secrets on EAS.

## Backend / Web Config
- `site/` Next.js project (likely deployed to Vercel, see `vercel.json`).
  - API routes under `site/app/api/` handle notifications, payments, review storage helper endpoints.
  - Middleware config plus Tailwind styling for web dashboard.
  - Email templates (`site/email-templates/*.html`) cover signup confirmation, MFA add/remove, identity linking, etc. Confirm SendGrid/Resend credentials in production env vars (`AUTH_EMAIL_SETUP.md`).
- `site/package.json` & `site/lib/` define server-side integrations (Supabase admin client, Stripe server key usage). Examine `.env.local` (not committed) for actual keys.

## Supabase Stack
- `supabase/config.toml` sets local ports, security hardening (OTP expiry, breach protection).
- Edge Functions (TypeScript):
  - `connect-express-login`, `connect-express-onboarding` — reviewer onboarding & account linkage.
  - `payments-create-sheet` — client secret generation for PaymentSheet.
  - `scheduled-expirations` — cleanup for pending requests.
  - `send-push-notification`, `send-sms-code`, `verify-sms-code`.
  - `stripe-webhook` — payment/refund/dispute event ingestion; ensure secret configured in Supabase dashboard.
- Database migrations (`supabase/migrations/*.sql`) cover reviewer metadata, payouts, refunds, waitlists, notifications, review storage, etc. Latest migrations add reviewee feedback prompts and payout balance updates; verify they are applied to production.

## Secrets & Config Checklist
1. **Expo/EAS**: `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`, notification keys (Expo or FCM), `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` if using monitoring.
2. **Next.js backend**: `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `RESEND_API_KEY`/`SENDGRID_API_KEY`, `EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `APPLE_PUSH_CERT` (if required), `IOS_PURCHASE_SRC_FLAG`.
3. **Supabase**: Secrets for Twilio (SMS), Resend, Expo push, Stripe Connect, Slack/webhook alerts configured via project settings (`supabase secrets set ...`).
4. **Stripe**: Connect platform live keys, webhook endpoints for both site backend and Supabase Edge functions, Connect application fee configuration, Apple Pay domain association.
